verdicts.why: Hoffman is in hiding with Owlsley until S1#13, when Daredevil saves him from Corbin's men and sends him to Mahoney, and he hires Nelson and Murdock as his lawyers before testifying. The whole stage happens in that episode.
In S1#5 Blake shoots Piotr for saying Fisk's name, which shows he is on Fisk's payroll. Fisk has Hoffman poison him in S1#8, and the split keeps that fact.
Matt and Claire kiss at his apartment in S1#5. The S1#11 goodbye stays in the split, at the stage's original title.

value.title: Daredevil S2#5
value.text: Elektra Natchios, Matt's ex-girlfriend from college, returns to pull him back into danger.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's ex from college. Pulls him back into danger.

split.title: Daredevil S2#13
split.text: Matt and Elektra fall for each other again before she dies in his arms.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Elektra's ex-boyfriend from college. They fall for each other again, and she dies in his arms.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's ex from college. Pulls him into danger and dies in his arms.

verdicts.why: Elektra only appears in the last moment of S2#4, standing in Matt's apartment. The college past comes out, and she asks for his help against Roxxon, in S2#5. So the stage as worded starts there. The split is correct.

The first fight is right: Elektra fights Matt at Midland Circle in #3. He already calls her by name in that fight, and she pauses at it. In #4 he tells Stick he hopes to reach her. Trying to reach her starts in #3, so the full text belongs there and no #5 split is needed.
Nobu first meets Elektra in S2#12, where he tells her she is the Black Sky and she helps Stick escape. He stabs her on the rooftop in S2#13, and the Hand takes her body at the end of that episode.
In S2#8 Stick tells Matt that Elektra belongs to the Chaste and works for him against the Hand. The flashbacks of Stick training young Elektra are in S2#12.
Lantom and Maggie care for the injured Matt together from S3#1. Lantom's secret about Maggie comes out in S3#9.
In S3#1 Lantom and Maggie take Matt to the Clinton Church basement to recover, and Lantom already talks with him about God and his survival.

value.title: Daredevil S3#4
value.text: Karen Page uncovers Felix Manning as the fixer who launders Wilson Fisk's money through Red Lion bank.

split.title: Daredevil S3#5
split.text: Manning tells Karen he doesn't fix problems, he makes them disappear, and he works to stop her from exposing Fisk.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Reporter Manning threatens with her own past.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fixer, who threatens Karen to keep her quiet.

verdicts.why: S3#4 is right: Tanya Mills names Manning to Karen. The proposal did not cut the S3#5 threat out of the stage text, so the text is cut here and the threat stays in the split.

In S3#7 Fisk's fixer is shown to have forced Melvin Potter, by threatening Betsy, to make the fake suit and trap Daredevil. Manning asks Fisk what to do about Betsy. The kidnapping and his deal to testify are in S3#13.

value.text: Felix Manning is the fixer Fisk relies on to keep Vanessa safe abroad.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Manning's boss. Relies on him to protect Vanessa.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fixer, who keeps Vanessa safe abroad.

split.title: Daredevil S3#5
split.text: Manning also moves Fisk's money, and he manages Fisk's affairs during his return.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Manning's boss. Relies on him to move money and protect Vanessa.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fixer, who moves his money and keeps Vanessa safe abroad.

verdicts.why: In S3#3 Fisk only learns through his lawyers that Manning hid Vanessa in Spain. The money laundering comes out in S3#4, and Manning first works with Fisk on screen in S3#5. So the money and the later management move to an S3#5 split.
Castle asks for Nelson and Murdock as his lawyers and pleads not guilty in S2#6. Foggy gives the opening statement in S2#7, calling Frank a hero failed by the system.
Jeri Hogarth first appears in S2#13, when Foggy joins her firm.
Karen is cleared and hired at Nelson and Murdock in S1#1, and Foggy is with her from that episode.

value.title: Daredevil S3#5
value.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem questions Foggy at his family's butcher shop about Matt's whereabouts.
value.on_a_card_about_b: FBI agent who questions Foggy about Matt.

split.title: Daredevil S3#12
split.text: Once Nadeem turns against Fisk, he works with Foggy, Matt and Karen to testify against him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: FBI agent who questions Foggy, then helps testify against Fisk.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's partner, whom Nadeem questions, then works with against Fisk.

verdicts.why: The S3#5 questioning at Nelson's Meats is right. In it Nadeem suggests Matt works for Fisk, and Foggy calls it an attempt to silence him. Moving the stage would carry 'ally' back to a hostile scene, so the S3#5 stage is set to rival.

value.on_a_card_about_b: Witness Foggy questions at Frank's trial.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Lawyer who questions Schoonover at Frank's trial.

split.text: Schoonover turns out to be the Blacksmith, the man behind the sniper attack on the DA's meeting that wounded Foggy.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Blacksmith, whose sniper attack wounded Foggy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Lawyer wounded in Schoonover's sniper attack.

verdicts.why: In S2#8 Foggy calls Schoonover alone, because Matt stays home that day, so 'Foggy Nelson and Matt question' is wrong. A friendly witness should not carry 'enemy' before the S2#12 Blacksmith reveal, so the S2#8 stage is set to ally. The split is right.
Frank's trial opens in S2#7. In his opening statement Foggy says the DA's office tried to cover up the Castle murders, against Reyes's opening.
Frank's only contact with Karen before S2#6 is the hospital attack. In S2#6 Karen tells him what she has found about his past and wins his cooperation. He saves her in S2#10.
The debate about killing is in S2#3, with Daredevil held captive. Nelson and Murdock take Frank's case in S2#6.
In S2#2 Reyes uses Grotto as bait to trap the Punisher and orders SWAT to open fire. Her own part in the Castle family's deaths is confirmed in S2#10.

value.text: Colonel Ray Schoonover, Frank's former commander and mentor, testifies for him at his trial.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's former commander and mentor, who testifies for him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Schoonover's former soldier, whom he speaks for at trial.

split.title: Daredevil S2#12
split.text: Schoonover is secretly the drug lord called the Blacksmith, whose deal led to the shootout that killed Frank's family, and Frank kills him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's former commander and mentor, secretly the Blacksmith. Frank kills him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Schoonover's former soldier, whose family dies over Schoonover's drug deal. Kills him in the end.

verdicts.why: Schoonover first appears in S2#8 as Frank's defense witness and calls him a hero. Keeping 'enemy' there would give away the S2#12 Blacksmith reveal, so the S2#8 stage is set to ally. The split is right.
In S2#1 Karen takes Grotto to the hospital and gets him out when the gunman attacks. The DA deal is in S2#2.
In S2#1 Grotto comes to Nelson and Murdock for protection from the shooter.
At the end of S3#8 Maggie prays to Jack about their son, and Matt overhears that she is his mother. That makes her Jack's former lover and the mother of Jack's son.
Jack appears in the S1#1 flashback, comforting nine-year-old Matt after the accident. The fixed fight and his murder are in S1#2.
In S1#8, after Gao's visit, Wesley brings Vanessa to calm Fisk down. He waits with Fisk at the hospital in S1#11.

value.on_a_card_about_b: A Russian boss Wesley gives orders to for his employer.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The right-hand man of a hidden boss, who gives Vladimir orders.

split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who deals with Vladimir, then wipes out his operation.

verdicts.why: Wesley deals with the Ranskahovs in S1#1, but for an employer who is not named until S1#3. Naming Fisk at S1#1 is a spoiler, and in S1#1 they are partners in the same crime alliance, not enemies. The S1#5 split stays.

value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man and closest friend.

split.on_a_card_about_b: Wesley's employer and closest friend, whose empire he runs.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man and closest friend, until Karen Page kills him.

verdicts.why: Wesley works for an unnamed, unseen employer in S1#1 and #2. Healy names him as Wilson Fisk, and Fisk first appears, in S1#3. Naming Fisk as Wesley's boss at S1#1 would spoil that reveal. The cut text and split are right.

verdicts.why: S2#5 is right: Ellison lets Karen into the Bulletin archives and helps her find the Central Park shootout. He is not yet her boss, though. He offers her the job in S2#12, so the S2#5 stage is set to ally. The card lines no longer call him her editor or her a reporter.

verdicts.why: S3#3 (taking her off the Fisk story) and the S3#7 firing are right. But the proposed S3#7 split also has Nadeem's video going public, and that only happens in S3#13. So the split becomes a list, with the video in S3#13.
In S2#4 Karen walks Matt home, they kiss, and they agree to have dinner. He tells her he is Daredevil in S2#13.
In S3#6 Matt comes to Karen for help finding Jasper Evans. They and Foggy bring Evans in to testify against Fisk.
Nobu has the Hand take the people Daredevil has helped, Karen among them, in S2#13. He and Karen have no contact before that.
In S3#11 Nadeem tells Mahoney privately that Karen will not be safe with the FBI, which lets the NYPD take her, and he defies Poindexter. The work together against Fisk is in S3#12.

Vanessa is poisoned in S1#10, but the viewer does not learn who did it until S1#12, when Owlsley and Gao talk about Fisk finding out they were behind it. Fisk is told in S1#13. Naming Owlsley at S1#10 would spoil the reveal.
Stick names Gao as one of the Hand's five fingers to Matt and the others in Defenders#4. The Defenders face Gao, Bakuto and Murakami at Midland in #7.

Gao's part in the S1#10 poisoning is hidden until S1#12, when she and Owlsley talk about Fisk learning they planned to kill Vanessa. Placing the stage at S1#10 names a hidden poisoner before the reveal.
Matt first meets Melvin at his workshop in S1#11 and asks him to make armor in exchange for stopping Fisk.
Nobu first shows up alive against Daredevil at the Farm at the end of S2#9.
